title: Asana pricing - Free for 10 users, then $10.99-$45 per user/month
clean_text: Asana's Personal plan is free forever for up to 10 users with unlimited tasks/projects and 200+ integrations. Paid tiers (annual billing) are Starter at $10.99/user/month, Advanced at $24.99/user/month, Enterprise at $35/user/month, and Enterprise+ at $45/user/month; monthly billing raises Starter to $13.49 and Advanced to $30.49 per user/month. Asana raised both Starter and Advanced list prices in 2026.
